title: Saudi Arabia Seeks to Lead Maritime Coalition to Protect Red Sea
title_cn: 沙特阿拉伯寻求领导海上联盟保护红海
summary: Saudi Arabia discussed with military representatives of 43 countries the formation of a multinational alliance charged with protecting maritime navigation, hoping to counter a blockade the Houthis imposed on the kingdom last week.

title: Trump Signs Order on Export Curbs to Retain Critical Minerals
title_cn: 特朗普签署限制出口命令以保留关键矿产
summary: President Donald Trump signed a measure Thursday that gives officials authority under the Defense Production Act to implement export restrictions on some industrial waste in a bid to retain critical minerals and rare elements contained in those products.

title: Why India's `Cockroach' Youth Are Angry
title_cn: 印度“蟑螂”青年为何愤怒
summary:
Rising youth unemployment in India has sparked the student-led “cockroach” movement, which has managed to oust a cabinet minister while presenting a growing challenge to Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: India Student Protesters Beat Modi's WhatsApp, X Playbook With Instagram Memes
title_cn: 印度学生抗议者用 Instagram Memes 击败莫迪的 WhatsApp、X Playbook
summary: As a wave of student-led protests swept India last week, Satvik Soni spent hours buried on Instagram broadcasting protest locations, explaining detainees’ rights and calling on demonstrators to report police misconduct. His tersely worded posts quickly racked up tens of thousands of views.
